free_tier.stated: USD 15 of free credits per month for every organization, about 2,000 Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minutes; 20 concurrent jobs by default; no card
free_tier.notes: the credit is US dollars spent per minute at each machine's rate: f1-standard-2 (x64) USD 0.0075, r1-standard-2 (ARM) USD 0.003, a2-standard-4 (macOS) USD 0.09; a job under one minute is billed as one minute

per_object_cap.stated: execution_time_limit is 1 hour by default and at most 24 hours (1,440 minutes); jobs are terminated at the limit, and a block or job limit longer than its pipeline's is rejected
per_object_cap.notes: no per-artifact size cap was found in the pages read

retention.stated: artifacts in the workflow and job namespaces are kept at most 400 days; project artifacts have no age limit; the agent and every file on it are discarded when the job ends

egress.terms: artifact egress is free up to 20 GB a month with 100 GB a month of artifact storage; beyond it USD 0.35 per GB of egress and USD 0.07 per GB of storage
egress.free_allowance: 20 GB of artifact egress a month

interface_detail: a pipeline YAML such as .semaphore/semaphore.yml in a GitHub or Bitbucket repository, or the visual workflow editor; the sem CLI opens an SSH session into a running job
tooling: Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 images on F1 x86_64 machines with Docker environments, Ubuntu 24.04 on R1 ARM machines, macOS Xcode images on A2 machines; the toolbox commands checkout, cache, artifact, sem-version and sem-service; the sem-ai CLI and an MCP server. The Community Edition is Apache-2.0 software the user installs and runs on a rented or free machine, after every hosted offer
chaining: a monthly dollar credit rather than a minute count, so the R1 ARM machine at USD 0.003 a minute stretches it furthest; artifacts leave free up to 20 GB a month, and the project artifact namespace has no age limit

limits.value: USD 15 of credit a month: about 2,000 minutes on f1-standard-2 (2 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 45 GB disk) at USD 0.0075 a minute; USD 15 / USD 0.003 = 5,000 minutes on r1-standard-2 (ARM, 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM)
20 concurrent jobs by default; higher limits on request
1 hour per pipeline by default, at most 24 hours (1,440 minutes)
20 GB a month of artifact egress and 100 GB a month of artifact storage free; then USD 0.35 per GB egress and USD 0.07 per GB storage
workflow and job artifacts are deleted after at most 400 days

limits_note: 9.6 GB of cache storage per project; time spent queued for a concurrency slot is not billed; the FAQ states that open-source and free plans cannot create private projects
binding_note: the USD 15 credit is spent at about 2,000 f1-standard-2 minutes a month, long before 20 concurrent jobs or the 24-hour job ceiling bind; a monthly minute pool has no kind of its own and sits under request-rate as in the other hosted CI records

identity_cost.detail: sign-up needs a GitHub or Bitbucket account; the free usage is advertised as 'Start free — $15/mo, no card'; the flow then asks for an organization name and a short survey

reliability_note: a job runs on an ephemeral agent destroyed at the end of the job; a shared runner address can already be at the Docker Hub anonymous pull limit
confidence_note: pricing, billing, machine-type, pipeline-YAML, artifact, FAQ and sign-up pages were read and quoted on 2026-10-30; no job was run. Raised to measured by a probe of a job on f1-standard-2.
